create_tensorboard_logger: create a TensorBoard logger instance that writes scalar metrics to a specified log directory
log_scalars_to_tensorboard: log a dictionary of scalar values with a step number to TensorBoard using TensorBoardLogger
log_hyperparameters_to_tensorboard: log hyperparameters and their corresponding meter values to TensorBoard using TensorBoardLogger
setup_logging_streams: setup stdout and optional file logging handlers with configurable log levels for distributed training
shutdown_logging_streams: shutdown all logging handlers and close open log file streams after training completes
